title: Missing axonmyelin mask with 3-class models (#1003)
prompt:
Bug report: when I segment images with a model that has 3 output classes (axon, myelin and
unmyelinated axon), the combined `<image>_seg-axonmyelin.png` mask is never written. With the
usual 2-class models (axon + myelin) it is. The axon and myelin masks themselves are saved fine.
This breaks `axondeepseg_morphometrics`, which needs the axonmyelin mask to overlay the index numbers.

Find the root cause, explain it briefly, and fix it with a minimal change.
final_answer:
The issue arises because the code only merges the axon and myelin masks into a single image when the model has exactly two output classes (axon and myelin). If the model has three output classes (axon, myelin, and unmyelinated axon), the merging step is skipped, resulting in the absence of the combined `<image>_seg-axonmyelin.png` mask.

To fix this, we need to modify the condition that checks the number of output classes. Instead of checking if the output classes are exactly `['axon', 'myelin']`, we should check if the classes include both 'axon' and 'myelin'. This way, the merging step will be performed regardless of whether there are additional classes.

Here is the *SEARCH/REPLACE* block to make this change:

AxonDeepSeg\apply_model.py
```python
<<<<<<< SEARCH
    if is_axonmyelin_seg:
        merge_masks(new_masks[0], new_masks[1])
=======
    if 'axon' in output_classes and 'myelin' in output_classes:
        merge_masks(new_masks[0], new_masks[1])
>>>>>>> REPLACE
```
